patterns.entry_requirement: Admission Requirements\s+((?:Applicants must|An AQF|A Bachelor|ATAR\s*:|Completion of|Successful completion|A minimum|An undergraduate|A completed|Admission to this program|For admission|Entry to this program)(?:.|\n){20,200})
patterns.fee: Annual indicative fee for international students \$([1-9][0-9]{1,2},[0-9]{3}(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)

config.notes: ANU Programs and Courses pages (programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/program/<CODE>, undated URL = next academic year; /<YEAR>/program/<CODE> = archived year): no page data. International annual fee after "Annual indicative fee for international students" (5+ digits; for programs under 48 units ANU prints the fee for the shorter program). Length after "Length", mode after "Mode of delivery". Start dates and English (IELTS) are not on these pages: English is set centrally by ANU English Language Admission Requirements; start dates are central (Semester 1 Feb, Semester 2 July) with program-specific notes only in free text. Built with the visual builder, draft 3f234771.
config.reason: Entry requirement pattern (review only); TAFE Queensland VET annual fee = international total course fee / full-time years from the international full-time offering row; Massey whole-qualification fee probe (no years, no fee computed) (Claude exit awards and requirements, on the Platform Admin instruction 5 Oct 15:22)
